name: Wayne Che Yip
bio: Writer/Director Wayne Yip graduated with a degree in Graphic Design at Oxford & Cherwell College in 2004. His career began initially in music videos but naturally progressed to short films. After the multiple award-winning short film 'Diego's Story', he directed Tom Bidwell's Would Like To Meet for Channel 4's 'Coming Up'. Wayne directs TV shows in both the UK and US. (IMDb)
